Translation.Job.Talents.Active.Scanner: Scans a biometric readout of a target within 8m.
Translation.BlockDesc.XXXX0: I have a nice little <style=DialogTerm>Safecracking</style> job for you.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.1: A VIP in {10} keeps all their secrets locked in a secure location. The problem is the safe has a biometric lock.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.2: With modern biometric systems, that's almost impossible to break through.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.3: Right. So before you break into the safe, you need to get close enough to the VIP to scan their biometrics.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.4: With a good scan it should be easy to crack the safe. But we'd need to get pretty close to get a scan.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.5: This Biometric Scanner should get you the reading you need. But make sure you don't kill that VIP. I don't need extra attention from this any more than you do.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.6: We can crack that safe for you.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.7_Male: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Safecracking</style> job. We need to get biometric data from the VIP and use it to open the safe.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking.7_Female: {1} has offered a <style=DialogTerm>Safecracking</style> job. We need to get biometric data from the VIP and use it to open the safe.
Translation.M_PGen_Safecracking.MissionDesc.1.Male: A leader in {10} has a safe with a biometric lock. {1} is offering a safecracking job to get some materials from the safe.
Translation.M_PGen_Safecracking.MissionDesc.1.Female: A leader in {10} has a safe with a biometric lock. {1} is offering a safecracking job to get some materials from the safe.
Translation.M_PGen_Safecracking.RoomDesc: We need to read biometric data from a VIP and use it to get into their safe.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Intro.2: The VIP is wandering the floor. We need to get one of us close enough to scan their biometric readings.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Intro.3: Once we have the readings, it is a simple matter to open the safe. The data will be shared with the entire team across the Quantum Rider system.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Intro.4: Any of us could walk up to the safe and open it. But security is high around the safe itself.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Intro.5: So, we sneak close to the VIP, read the biometric data, get through the security around the safe, open the safe, and get out fast?
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Intro.6: Don't forget we can't kill the VIP. If necessary, take down the guards, but sneaking in and out would be safest.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Intro.7: The safe is located in a secure area and has a biometric lock. Our biometric scanner can get the readings of the VIP that we need, but it only has a range of 12m. Killing the VIP will cause mission defeat.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_KilledVIP.1_M: The VIP is down! {1} will be angry.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_KilledVIP.1_F: The VIP is down! {1} will be angry.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_KilledVIP.2: Let's get out of here, the mission is over.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Scanned.1: I have the biometric reading. Get to the safe quickly so we can get out of here!
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Done.1: I've got the safe open. All their secrets are in my hand. Let's go!
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Done.2: Scramble for the exit. We are done here.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Exit.1_Male: The safe is cracked and we are out of here. You know your escape routes, I'll see you at the Safehouse.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Exit.1_Female: The safe is cracked and we are out of here. You know your escape routes, I'll see you at the Safehouse.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Victory.1: We cracked the biometric safe and stole their secrets.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_Defeat.1: Security was too tight. We couldn't get close enough to crack the safe.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_DeadDefeat.1: Didn't I tell not to kill the VIP?
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_DeadDefeat.2: The firefight got intense. The VIP went down in the crossfire.
Translation.Dialog.D_PGen_Safecracking_DeadDefeat.3: This is going to hamper my operations.
